decisions.reason: This relaunch SEO support service fits the firm's core e-commerce, analytics, usability and search-marketing capabilities very closely, has remained visible across 2023 and 2024, and should be easy for the firm to improve through learning from client projects.

SEO workshops also build on the firm's existing search and consulting knowledge, but as a newer and somewhat less central training-format offer than its implementation services, they face a higher chance of being discontinued if demand or margins are weaker than expected.
